note: Janssen et al. (2022) identified a cohort of eight individuals with de novo TAF4 loss-of-function variants, documenting frequent hypotonia and infrequent seizures.

evidence.text: Janssen et al. described eight individuals harboring de novo putative loss-of-function TAF4 variants presenting with neurodevelopmental features, including generalized hypotonia and infrequent seizures.

source.title: De novo putative loss‐of‐function variants in TAF4 are associated with a neuro‐developmental disorder
source.quote: We here present a cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neuro-developmental disorder (NDD).
